ev.q: The age-adjusted death rate from such collisions was highest for American Indian or Alaska Native persons
The age-adjusted death rate from such collisions was highest for American Indian or Alaska Native persons
followed by Black or African American (4.4), Hispanic or Latino (3.0), White (1.9), and Asian (1.4) persons
Source: National Vital Statistics System, Underlying Cause of Death, 2018–2021.

methods_quotes.q: were identified using the International Classification of Diseases, Tenth Revision codes V02–V04, V09[.0,.2].
